Recent research publications and selected academic updates. For the full bibliography, see [Publications](publications.qmd).

## 2026

::: {.news-entry}
::: {.news-year}
2026
:::
::: {.news-body}
### CisCAR research published in *Molecular Therapy Oncology*

Our study introduces focused-ultrasound-controllable CisCAR T cells that express their own target antigen to trigger self-activation and local bystander killing, including against antigen-negative tumor cells.

[Read the paper ↗](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.omton.2026.201323)
:::
:::

::: {.news-entry}
::: {.news-year}
2026
:::
::: {.news-body}
### Ultrasound-primed CAR T-cell therapy reported in *Science Advances*

Our collaborative work explores a tumor-hallmark-gated, ultrasound-primed approach to guide CAR T-cell activity in solid tumors.

[Read the paper ↗](https://doi.org/10.1126/sciadv.aed0666)
:::
:::

### EchoBack-CAR T-cell study published in *Cell*

Our collaborative study reports a sonogenetic platform for engineering externally controllable CAR T cells.

[Read the paper ↗](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2025.02.035)

::: {.news-entry}
::: {.news-year}
2025

::: {.news-body}
### Ultrasound mechanogenetics for CAR T-cell therapy reported in *Nature Materials*

Our collaborative research investigates ultrasound-based tumor priming as an approach to improve CAR T-cell treatment.

[Read the paper ↗](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41563-025-02391-8)
:::

::: {.news-body}
### PDbody study published in *ACS Nano*

We engineered a PD-L1-targeting monobody through directed evolution and incorporated it into a SynNotch-gated cellular therapy system.

[Read the paper ↗](https://doi.org/10.1021/acsnano.4c01597)
